summary: Employee model definition. Salary is a string (legacy quirk). Status is an int 0-3. HR-department employees have special delete protection noted here.
GET all employees. Filters out Status=3 (terminated) by default. Downstream reports depend on this.
POST create employee. Validates first/last name required. Defaults salary to 'TBD' if blank. Forces new hires to Status=0 (active).
PUT update employee. Blocks department changes for HR/Finance employees. Salary is explicitly NOT updatable here by design.
DELETE employee. Blocks deletion for HR department. Always a soft delete (Status -> 3/Terminated), never a hard delete, per compliance requirement.
Raw ADO.NET SQL access to Employees table. Shows actual column names and that ManagerEmpId uses string '0' as a no-manager sentinel.
